name: Traits
description: Concrete intrinsic creature capabilities and bonuses

fields.description: Can breathe and act normally both underwater and on land.
+2 to {{ ability:perception.name }} actions when detecting or tracking by scent.
+2 to {{ ability:perception.name }} actions that rely on hearing.
Cannot be blinded by ordinary darkness.
Can perceive nearby creatures and obstacles without sight while able to emit and hear sound.
+2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to climb or keep balance on difficult ground.
+1 to {{ ability:strength.name }} actions involving pushing, lifting, or breaking objects.
+1 to Reflexes against threats the creature can perceive.
Can fly at its normal movement speed while its wings are free.
Ignores damage from the first 10 meters of a fall and may move 2 meters horizontally per meter descended.
Can move through loose earth at half its normal movement speed and leaves a traversable tunnel.
Moves through water at its normal movement speed and gains +1 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to swim.
At the start of its turn, recovers 5% of maximum HP if it has at least 1 HP; the following weakness prevents this recovery for that turn: {{ weakness.name }}.
Takes no damage and suffers no harmful effects from ordinary fire or heat.
Takes no damage and suffers no harmful effects from ordinary cold or ice.
Cannot be poisoned and takes no damage from mundane toxins.
Cannot contract or transmit ordinary diseases.
Can pass through nonmagical creatures and solid objects at half speed but must end movement in an open space.
+2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to hide in the creature's native environment.
+1 to attack actions against a target adjacent to one of the creature's allies.
+1 damage with unarmed attacks made using claws, fangs, horns, or another natural weapon.
After a natural attack deals damage, the target gains the {{ status_effect:poisoned.name }} status effect and loses 1 AP unless it resists the poison.
Can create strong webs that inflict the {{ status_effect:restrained.name }} status effect on a target and gains +2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to move across them.
Does not need to breathe and gains +2 to {{ ability:constitution.name }} actions made to resist impacts.
+2 to {{ ability:perception.name }} actions made to detect active spells or enchanted objects nearby.
+1 to the next action made to grapple or inflict the {{ status_effect:prone.name }} status effect on a target after moving at least 3 meters toward it in the same turn.
+1 to the next melee attack after moving at least 5 meters straight toward the target in the same turn.
+2 to {{ ability:strength.name }} actions made to maintain or tighten an existing grapple.
Can move along steep or vertical rough surfaces at half its normal movement speed without a routine {{ ability:climbing.name }} roll.
Detects movement within 10 meters without sight while it and the source are in contact with the same ground.
Detects nearby heat sources within 10 meters without sight, though solid barriers block this sense.
Can hold or manipulate one light object with its tail, but gains no additional action.
+2 to {{ ability:strength.name }} or {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to jump.
Can flow through openings large enough for one member and occupy another creature’s space, but remains one creature for actions and effects.
+1 to actions made to resist hostile magical effects.
Can make ordinary close attacks from up to 2 meters farther away than a similar-sized creature.
Can communicate mentally with nearby creatures without requiring a shared spoken language.
+2 on its first offensive action against a target that has not detected it.
The first time on each of its turns that a natural attack deals damage, recovers 5% of its maximum HP, rounded down to a minimum of 1 HP; later attacks that turn restore no HP.
+1 to attacks and {{ ability:speed.name }}-based pursuit actions against creatures at or below half their maximum HP or visibly bleeding.
A creature that damages it with a direct close attack must resist or take 1 damage from spines or a similar natural defense.
When it dies, each other creature within 2 meters must resist or take damage equal to 5% of this creature’s maximum HP, rounded down to a minimum of 1 damage.
Once per turn after making a natural attack, can make one additional natural attack with a -2 attack penalty that deals half its normal damage, rounded down to a minimum of 1 damage.
Cannot gain the {{ status_effect:frightened.name }} status effect.
